mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the potato cover was most worthwhile because it showed how the bed protects developing tubers while still admitting light to the shoots and allowing drainage and air.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the opaque cover was the least engaging passage: it gave a predictable result without further detail at that point.
